title_as_printed: DIAMOND HARBOUR LORAN C STATION MASTER LEDGER

sections.title: Introduction
sections.text: LORAN C Station at Diamond Harbour was de-commissioned on 2006, since then one LHA was posted to look after the station.

fields.label: iii. No. of Fruit Bearing Trees
xii. Postal Address
fields.value: Diamond Harbour, LORAN C Station PO & PS - Diamond Harbour Dist. South 24 Parganas West Bengal — 743 331

sections.title: Electricity
sections.text: 3 Phase, 440V, 50Hz Electric Mains Supply is available from WBDCEL.

sections.title: Water Supply
sections.text: Bore well water is available in the Station.

sections.title: Mode ofApproach
sections.text: The station is well connected by all weather road. The nearest Railway Station is Diamond Harbour railway station which is approx.6 Km and nearest Airport is Kolkata which is approx. 86 km from Station.

sections.title: Facilities Available
sections.text: Post Office, Primary Health Center, Police Station and School all are within radius of 8 KM from Diamond Harbour LORAN C Station.
